newsitem.title: UK: Air Canada flies record tonnage ex-Heathrow.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada flies record tonnage ex-Heathrow.

text.p: Last week Air Canada flew a record 650 tonnes from Heathrow, its UK and Ireland cargo manager Mike Judkins said.
Much of this cargo was destined for the U.S. and likewise much will have originated in continental Europe before being trucked to Heathrow, he added.
Last week's cargo featured vegetables from the Netherlands, Belgium and Italy.
July is also the best so far this year for U.K generated revenue and is amongst the highest seen in 1996, Judkins said.

Air Canada's cargo this week included a Rolls-Royce aero engine for Boeing flown from London on Wednesday in a Toronto bound 747 Combi. Judkins said the engine would then be flown to Vancouver on another 747 Combi flight before being trucked to Seattle.
